name.zh: 异齿龙（D. milleri 启发成年形态）

description.en: Dimetrodon, a non-mammalian synapsid rather than a dinosaur, inspired by the D. milleri museum material. Sail tissue, colour and pose are interpretive; the sail function and species-exact anatomy are not asserted.
description.zh: 异齿龙是非哺乳类合弓动物而非恐龙，以馆藏 D. milleri 材料为主要启发。帆部软组织、颜色和姿态为推断，不断言帆的功能或物种级精确解剖。
